# Road to Desert

> Curated Morocco travel experiences featuring guided desert tours, kasbah explorations, and multi-day adventures from major cities to the Sahara.

Road to Desert specializes in organizing comprehensive Morocco tours departing from key cities like Marrakech, Fez, Casablanca, and Tangier, with a focus on Sahara Desert experiences, Atlas Mountains trekking, and authentic Berber cultural encounters. The company offers flexible multi-day packages ranging from 3 to 8 days, catering to adventure seekers and cultural travelers.

- [7-Day Moroccan Adventure: Journey from South to North - Road to desert](https://roadtodesert.com/st_tour/7-day-moroccan-adventure-journey-from-south-to-north): 7-day Marrakech to Tangier journey via Fez and Sahara Desert

- [5 Days from Marrakech to Ouzina & Merzouga - Road to desert](https://roadtodesert.com/st_tour/5-days-from-marrakech-to-ouzina-merzouga): 5-day Marrakech tour to Ouzina and Merzouga Sahara desert
